event.next_door.5.text: ...He said it. Out loud, with a witness. I need to sit. The sign hook next door is still empty. The sign's drawn. It's under the coal.
event.next_door.5.why: drops Marcus's 'measured it. Twice' shape; calls back the heart 2 sketches under the coal

event.story_notes_juno.after.text: Bram's had six. He keeps every one in his apron pocket. He thinks they're from Tilda. Let him.
event.story_notes_juno.after.why: third 'Don't tell Bram' cut; same fact, now a private conspiracy

dlg.juno.birthday.r0.text: Thank you! I'm framing that. The actual words. I'll need a very thin frame.
dlg.juno.birthday.r0.why: drops a repeated 'Don't tell Bram'; frame still pays off in the wish branch

event.juno_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.juno.wish}It's framed now, next to the first clasp that ever closed. Click is very proud.{else}{if choice:bday.juno.tease}The cake label stays. I'm adding a second one: 'Yes, Really'. Bram saw and backed away slowly.{else}A gift, from you, on my birthday. It's on the anvil. Everything else in here orbits it now.{/if}{/if}
event.juno_birthday.after.why: tease branch no longer spends Bram's 'Eat' label, which is the payoff of overheard_juno_bram_2

event.juno_heart4.setup.text: Freeze! Right there. Don't move. I have a surprise, and it's very sticky.
event.juno_heart4.setup.why: 'Okay, okay, okay' thinned to a signature

event.juno_heart4.reaction.text: {if choice:label.accept}A label that stays! Next I'm doing the whole village. The hall roof gets 'Nearly (Fixed)'.{else}{if choice:label.relabel}'Apprentice (Chaotic)', on my forehead, all day. Bram read it and moved the tongs out of my reach.{else}Nobody's ever eaten a label! I'm thrilled. I'm a little worried. I'm making a drawer that says 'Not Food'.{/if}{/if}
event.juno_heart4.reaction.why: Bram's 'nodded. Twice.' undercut heart 10, where one nod is the event

event.juno_heart5.0.text: I finished it! I finished it! Eleven evenings. Bram fixed one rivet, and I pretended not to see.
event.juno_heart5.0.why: tic thinned; excitement carried by repetition instead

dlg.juno.strike.r1.text: Together? You hold the tongs, like the first day. I tap the bend. Ready? Go!
dlg.juno.strike.r1.why: calls back heart 2's tongs; tic removed

event.juno_heart8.intro.text: Okay, okay, okay. Today's the right day. I'm showing Bram the horseshoe. Stand next to me? I sweat less with company.
event.juno_heart8.intro.why: answers heart 6's 'I have to pick the right day'

event.juno_heart10.intro.text: Hold out your hand. Both hands. I made a mark, my own, and I stamped it before I told a single person.
event.juno_heart10.intro.why: heart 8, heart 10 and next_door all opened 'Okay, okay, okay'

event.juno_heart10.thanks.text: {if choice:shoe.wait}Bram saw the mark. He waited, like you did, then nodded once. Once! Next door has an empty sign hook.{else}Bram saw the mark and said 'Hm.' The good 'Hm.' I'd know. Next door has an empty sign hook.{/if}
event.juno_heart10.thanks.why: framing joke belonged to the birthday; now remembers heart 8's two kinds of 'Hm'

event.juno_friend.intro.text: Quick, quick! Come see the swimming pool. It's a bucket. Wren named it. I made the sign.

event.juno_courtship2.intro.text: The list has forty-one items now. Forty-one is 'patient'. I've been so patient! So. Would you court me?
event.juno_courtship2.intro.why: tic thinned; the list carries the callback

dlg.juno.courtship.r0.text: Yes? YES. Okay. Item one is your muddy hat. I can't read item two. My hands are shaking. Courting!
dlg.juno.courtship.r0.why: the choice asks for the list; now she starts reading it

event.juno_courtship.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.juno.yes}Bram says I'm vibrating. I am. The tongs are too. Item two is your laugh, by the way.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.juno.friends}Friends, labeled, on the shelf next to the first clasp. That's the good shelf.{else}Take your time. I'll start item forty-one. It's 'patient'.{/if}{/if}
event.juno_courtship.after.why: no longer repeats r0's 'Courting!' or closes on 'Thank you'; leaves thirty-eight items unread

event.juno_courtship2.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.juno.yes}Finally! Bram says I'm vibrating. I am. I'm crossing out 'patient'. It was never my best item.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.juno.friends}Friends, labeled, on the shelf next to the first clasp. That's the good shelf.{else}Take your time. Item forty-two is 'still patient'. It's underlined.{/if}{/if}
event.juno_courtship2.after.why: drops the 'Thank you' close; remembers item forty-one

dlg.juno.partners.0.text: Bram banked the forge and shooed me out. The afternoon's ours. What are we doing?
dlg.juno.partners.0.why: scene plays 9 to 17, so not 'evening'; tic thinned

dlg.story.band.talk.r1.text: We won! Bram, we won! ...Bram? He's hitting the thing. Twice!

notes: Tic pass: 'Okay, okay, okay' cut from 8 scene openings; it now opens 5 of 25 scenes (heart2, heart8, next_door, birthday, courtship).
Bram: story_notes_juno.after still states six notes in his apron that he thinks are Tilda's; it is his to accept or veto.
overheard_juno_bram_2 (Bram writes 'Eat' on her cake) is no longer told in advance by the birthday tease branch, so it plays fresh in any order.
Marcus's hall_dance line 'I measured this floor for it. Twice.' now owns the measuring joke; I gave it up in next_door.
